plugins.name: skillartisan
plugins.description: Build, validate, secure, and maintain Claude Skills. Supersedes Anthropic's shipped skill-creator with a spec-compliant, cross-vendor, security-hardened successor: frontmatter validation, a combined decision/dedup gate, a five-surface compatibility matrix, gitleaks-based security scanning with tamper detection, the full with/without-skill evaluation engine, lifecycle classification, and an audit mode for upgrading, rebuilding, and bulk-auditing existing skills.
